text: もちろん　＊と　しょうぶ　するために　ここに　きたのじゃな！

structure.jp: ＊と　しょうぶ　するために
ここに　きたのじゃな！

patterns.name: 〜ために
patterns.span: しょうぶ　するために
patterns.explanation: ために after a verb gives the goal, 'in order to'. しょうぶ　するために = 'in order to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のじゃ is the old-man form of のだ. Here it shows he is working out the reason behind what he sees. きたのじゃ = 'so that's why you came'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end checks that the listener agrees, like 'right?'. きたのじゃな = 'you came for that, didn't you'.
